paragraphs.en: I am Larry Meade. I am President of the Northern Virginia Bird Club.
paragraphs.zh: 我是拉里·米德。我是北弗吉尼亚鸟类俱乐部的主席。

paragraphs.en: I've always been interested in birding, but I've been seriously birding, keeping track since 2002.
paragraphs.zh: 我一直对观鸟感兴趣，但从2002年起我才开始认真观鸟并持续记录。

paragraphs.en: The connotation of bird watching is that all we do is watch the birds.
paragraphs.zh: 观鸟的内涵在于全心全意地看鸟。

paragraphs.en: But birding is more of an all-encompassing concept because not only do we look at them, we study them. We do scientific surveys.
paragraphs.zh: 但是观鸟是一个更包罗万象的概念，因为我们不仅观察鸟类，还研究它们。我们进行科学调查。

paragraphs.en: Looked like a juvenile to me because I saw an adult fly to the right.
paragraphs.zh: 这只看起来像只幼鸟，因为我看到一只成鸟飞向了右边。

paragraphs.en: We study their behavior. The one behind me in the pine tree. We travel to see them. We are at Huntley Meadows Park.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究它们的行为。我身后松树上的那只。我们跋山涉水去看他们。我们在亨特利草地公园。

paragraphs.en: What is really unique about this is it is a freshwater wetland which is unusual. It's got the nice boardwalk.
paragraphs.zh: 真正的独特之处在于，这里是一片罕见的淡水湿地。这里还有漂亮的木板步道。

paragraphs.en: It's pretty unique in that way and that you can get really pretty close to the birds and other wildlife. Now, the Great Crested Flycatcher is back.
paragraphs.zh: 这里真的非常独特，你可以非常接近鸟类和其他野生动物。大冠蝇霸鹟回来了。

paragraphs.en: Jessica is a member of our club. Here's another. Here's a Tree Swallow right here. I hear him singing. It's nice to be able to share experiences.
paragraphs.zh: 杰西卡是我们俱乐部的成员。这是另一只。这里有一只树燕。我听到它在唱歌。能够分享这些经历真好。

paragraphs.en: If I'm by myself, I like to post my photos on Facebook and get reaction from people that way.
paragraphs.zh: 如果只有我自己的话，我喜欢在脸书上分享我拍的照片，通过那种方式得到大家的反馈。

paragraphs.en: But when we're with a person, number one, it's another set of eyes, like she spotted some Cedar Waxwings I probably wouldn't have seen.
paragraphs.zh: 但当我们和另一个人在一起时，首先就多了一双眼睛，她发现了一些我可能不会看到的雪松太平鸟。

paragraphs.en: And I spotted some stuff she probably wouldn't have seen.
paragraphs.zh: 当然我也会看到一些她错过的鸟类。

paragraphs.en: So, you've got more chance to see the birds, but you can also discuss the birds and just catching up with friends, too. It's just a social thing.
paragraphs.zh: 你有更多的机会看更多的鸟，而且你还可以和朋友们一起讨论鸟儿，叙叙旧。这就是一种社交活动。

paragraphs.en: Being outside is always rewarding regardless of the weather, regardless of what it is that we get to see, because the outdoors is always a surprise.
paragraphs.zh: 无论天气如何，无论我们能看到什么，待在户外总会有所收获，因为户外总是充满惊喜。

paragraphs.en: You never know what you're going to find. Back in 2013, I was playing around on the Internet and found an app that I could download on my phone that was a birding app.
paragraphs.zh: 你永远不知道你会发现什么。早在2013年，我上网时发现了一款可以下载到手机上的应用程序，那是一款观鸟应用。

paragraphs.en: And so that kind of piqued my interest. And then I went and got a book about birding and realized just how intricate and detailed it really is.
paragraphs.zh: 这激起了我的兴趣。然后我去买了一本观鸟的书，并意识到观鸟是多么的错综复杂和细致入微。

paragraphs.en: Birding kind of became like a scavenger hunt. And Larry mentioned earlier that birders keep a life list, which is a list of all the birds that they've seen.
paragraphs.zh: 观鸟变得有点像寻宝游戏。而拉里之前提到过，每个观鸟人都有一份人生清单，上面列有他们看过的所有鸟类。

paragraphs.en: And so, when you start out and everything feels new, you're sort of, you know, adding to that life list and it's growing and it's growing and it just becomes addictive.
paragraphs.zh: 当你刚开始观鸟，一切感觉都很新鲜时，你会不断往人生清单里添加内容，清单越列越长，而且这会让人上瘾。

paragraphs.en: It's good for your health to be outdoors. It's a very calming experience.
paragraphs.zh: 待在户外对你的健康有益。这是一种非常平静的体验。

paragraphs.en: But personally, as a former educator, I believe that everybody should be connected to nature because we have to conserve nature.
paragraphs.zh: 但是就我个人而言，作为一名前教育工作者，我认为每个人都应该与自然建立联系，因为我们必须保护自然。

paragraphs.en: The birds are diminishing. The research shows that we've lost over 3 million birds over the past few decades and that's really scary.
paragraphs.zh: 鸟类正在减少。 研究表明，在过去的几十年里，我们失去了超过300万只鸟，这真的很可怕。

paragraphs.en: And I think that people aren't going to be aware of that if they're not connected to it.
paragraphs.zh: 我认为，如果人们不和自然建立联系，他们就不会意识到这一点。

paragraphs.en: In many places, the only legitimate place to go other than the grocery store and the hospital, is the outdoors.
paragraphs.zh: 在许多地方，除了杂货店和医院，唯一合法的去处是户外。

paragraphs.en: And it's a safe place to be right now as long as you keep your distance from other people.
paragraphs.zh: 只要你和其他人保持距离，户外就是当下安全的地方。

paragraphs.en: And so, people are going outside in ways that they never have before. And they're noticing things that they hadn't noticed before.
paragraphs.zh: 人们正以前所未有的方式走向户外。他们也注意到了以前从未留意过的事物。

paragraphs.en: And they are making that connection. And they're finding that birdwatching or birding, as we like to call it, is very relaxing.
paragraphs.zh: 他们正在与自然建立这种联系。他们会发现观鸟非常令人放松。

paragraphs.en: The basic tools for a birder are binoculars and some kind of field guide so you can figure out what the birds are.
paragraphs.zh: 观鸟者的基本工具是双筒望远镜和野外指南，这样你就能辨认出鸟类的品种。

paragraphs.en: I really like the Red-headed Woodpecker. That's one of my favorites.
paragraphs.zh: 我真的很喜欢红头啄木鸟。这是我的最爱之一。

paragraphs.en: I would encourage people to pay attention to birds. There is a whole worldwide community of birders.
paragraphs.zh: 我鼓励人们关注鸟类。我们聚集了全球的观鸟者群体。

paragraphs.en: I mean it's not just here. It's everywhere. It's just a lot of fun.
paragraphs.zh: 观鸟不只是在某个地方流行，而是在世界各地都有人参与。这非常有趣。
